findings.title: formal vocative summons
findings.claim: The opening vocative turns the ayah from reported speech into a direct summons to the believing community.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:1:1 interrupts the preceding third-person flow and scopes remembrance, guardedness, and reliance as commands to the called audience.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the coming instructions as addressed obligation rather than detached narration.
findings.containment: This establishes address force only; it does not identify the remembered event or add a command beyond the supplied ayah.

epistemic.reason: The vocative carrier directly opens a command-address and scopes the following imperatives to the summoned community.

findings.title: vocative class hinge
findings.claim: The vocative support form makes the addressee a class that can be named by the following relative phrase.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:1:2 completes the formal call and bridges attention to the following relative phrase, so the first imperative waits until the class is specified.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices a defined audience being assembled before the instruction begins.
findings.containment: This describes the form's local connective work; it does not claim an independent lexical meaning for the support form.

epistemic.reason: The support form is locally tied to the definite class phrase and makes the vocative-to-command transition explicit.

findings.title: defined believer address
findings.claim: The relative pronoun makes the audience definite through the following belief clause.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:2:1 opens a definite relative construction; the summons therefore selects those identified by prior belief before the imperatives land.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees who is being addressed without the translation having to spell out the grammatical selection.
findings.containment: The definiteness identifies the addressed class locally; it does not make a wider claim about everyone named as a believer elsewhere.

epistemic.reason: The definite relative carrier and its following clause directly establish the audience before the commands.

findings.title: trust identity frame
findings.claim: The perfect Form IV verb presents belief and trust as the audience's prior identity, which the closing believer noun later reprises.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:3:1-2 is a completed-form verb inside the relative clause, placing trust before the imperative sequence and framing the later reliance command.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is a trust-bearing identity here, not a bare label attached after the danger scene.
findings.containment: The claim stays with the local trust-security frame; it does not turn the verb into a separate doctrinal exposition.

epistemic.reason: The completed Form IV carrier is securely located inside the relative clause, while its broader security-and-trust field is narrowed to the local audience identity.

findings.title: active memory command
findings.claim: The remembrance command treats the past favor as an action the addressees must actively re-present.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:4:1-2 is a second-person plural imperative, so the threat scene becomes the content of an action demanded in the present.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the past rescue brought into present obligation rather than left as passive recollection.
findings.containment: This concerns the command's local force; it does not claim that remembering excludes other forms of gratitude.

epistemic.reason: The imperative carrier and its object relation directly make remembrance an assigned action in the focus ayah.

findings.title: favor as protection
findings.claim: The accusative construct object names the remembered favor as the concrete protection enacted in the following rescue scene.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:5:1 is both the object of remembrance and the head of the divine-name construct; the restrained hands give this broad favor a visible local form.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see what the abstract favor consists of here: hostile reach being stopped.
findings.containment: The local protective sense is retained within the wider favor field; it does not reduce every use of the word to physical rescue.

epistemic.reason: The accusative construct object is secure, and the supplied analysis bounds its broad favor field to the protection enacted in the following scene.

findings.title: divine source of favor
findings.claim: The genitive divine name makes the favor God's own act and source.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:6:1 completes the construct headed by favor, attributing the remembered benefaction to God rather than to impersonal fortune.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the rescue as a relation from God to the addressed community.
findings.containment: This uses the divine name in its local source role and does not assert a derivational account of the name.

epistemic.reason: The genitive relation directly identifies the source and possessor of the favor; broader derivational questions are outside this local claim.

epistemic.reason: The preposition and second-person suffix directly scope the favor to the addressees, while the wider directional pattern is kept as a bounded local relation.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command to remember descend into a specific rescue scene.
findings.containment: The temporal relation anchors the event without specifying a historical setting that the packet does not supply.

epistemic.reason: The temporal carrier directly introduces the completed threat event as the occasion of remembrance.

findings.title: rescue to command connector

findings.title: fronted reliance foundation
findings.claim: The fronted preposition puts the basis of reliance before the act commanded.

findings.title: God as reliance foundation
findings.claim: The genitive divine name completes the fronted phrase and identifies God as reliance's foundation.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:21:1 completes the phrase governed by upon, shifting the divine-name relation from source of favor to foundation of reliance.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the third local relation to God: favor from God, guardedness toward God, and reliance upon God.
findings.containment: The claim is limited to the supplied clause relation and does not turn the repeated name into a separate derivational argument.

epistemic.reason: The genitive divine-name carrier completes the fronted support phrase and directly identifies its foundation.

findings.title: foundation into command
findings.claim: The result particle converts the fronted Godward foundation into an ensuing command to rely.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:22:1 joins the fronted phrase to the command lām and jussive verb, tightening the transition from basis to response.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the named foundation immediately become an ordered act.
findings.containment: This is the local transition into the closing command; it does not claim that the particle independently supplies the command's content.

epistemic.reason: The particle directly links the fronted support phrase to the command sequence and makes foundation become action.

findings.title: third-person command marker
findings.claim: The bound command lām changes the closing from direct second-person address to a general injunction.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:22:2 governs the following jussive verb, putting command force in the prefix slot before the explicit believer-class subject appears.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing broaden from the summoned you to a general statement about believers.
findings.containment: This describes person and command structure only; it does not imply a weaker command.

epistemic.reason: The bound command lām visibly governs the following jussive and changes the address pattern at the close.

findings.title: active entrusted reliance
findings.claim: The Form V jussive calls for active reliance as entrusting oneself to God, not vague optimism.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:22:3 is governed by the command lām and receives the fronted upon-God complement, making reliance an enacted delegated trust.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final command asks for an active relation of entrusting and relying.
findings.containment: This retains the ordinary command to rely and adds its entrusted-reliance pressure; it does not claim passivity or guarantee a particular outcome.

epistemic.reason: The Form V jussive and its fronted complement directly support active reliance as entrusting, while the supplied broader root field is kept local.

findings.title: believer class closure
findings.claim: The final definite active participle names believers as the ongoing class whose identity culminates in reliance.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:11:23:1-2 supplies the explicit subject of the reliance command and returns the trust-bearing root to the ayah's final position.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah close on believers defined by reliance rather than on the enemy or the hands.
findings.containment: The participle marks the class and its ongoing identity in this command; it does not rank believers or add a separate membership test.

epistemic.reason: The explicit nominative active participle closes the jussive clause and reprises the opening belief designation.

findings.claim: The ayah depicts protection as preemptive interception: a resolved hostile purpose loses effective reach before injury is narrated.
findings.mechanism: The focus sequence connects inward resolve, projected hand-extension, repeated hands as capacity, and completed restraint; the same action channel is stopped between intention and effective reach.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the rescue at the threshold where a plan becomes force.

findings.title: O1-restraint-as-sufficing-care
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the restraint also resonates as sufficient guardianship: the entrusted guardian both blocks the threat and carries protection through.
findings.mechanism: The focus restraint carrier contacts the focus reliance and guardian form; the supplied trace therefore connects stopping the hostile channel with an entrusted sufficiency relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive protection as sustained care as well as interruption.
findings.containment: This is the packet's bounded intraradical resonance, using the non-dominant K-F-Y mapping carried under the focus K-F-F restraint form. It is attributed and exploratory, never a replacement gloss for the restraint verb.

epistemic.reason: The trace has exact focus coordinates and a supplied carrier-trigger relation, but its source is legacy-unbound and its own packet containment marks it as exploratory.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Edimin sonucu, bir açığın kapanması, ihtiyacın karşılanması ve amaçlanan sonuca ulaşılmasıdır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The interruption also resonates as protection that is enough to carry the threatened affair through.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains an attributed intraradical resonance and does not replace the ordinary restraint reading.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Reliance can be heard as entrusting the threatened affair to a sufficient guardian after the hands are restrained.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not invent a separate guardian figure or make the exploratory image the translation.
